nodes.display_name: Mail in one mailbox is readable
nodes.remediation: Grant the `Mail.Read` application permission and admin-consent it, or, when the app is scoped with Exchange RBAC for Applications or an application access policy, add the mailbox to that scope. Exchange takes 30 minutes to two hours to apply the change.
